description: Searches Italian municipalities (comuni) by name, tolerating partial names and typos, and returns each match with its 6-digit ISTAT code, province and region. Use it when you have a place name and need the code; when you already have the 6-digit code, do not search again and use leggi_dati_comune instead, to pick comuni by criteria use classifica_territori, and to browse a province use elenca_territori. All homonyms are returned, most similar first (narrow them with `provincia` or `regione`); an empty list means nothing resembles the text and is not an error. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

nome.description: Name of the comune, full or partial, 2-80 characters, in any case; typos, missing accents and apostrophes are tolerated ("cassano adda" finds Cassano d'Adda).

provincia.description: Optional: keep only comuni of this province, given by its Italian name in any case ("Trento", "Bolzano", "Monza e Brianza").

regione.description: Optional: keep only comuni of this region, given by its Italian name ("Toscana", not "Tuscany"; Bolzano and Trento are in "Trentino-Alto Adige").

name: cerca_comune

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Set only when `provincia` or `regione` excluded every match: how many comuni with a similar name exist elsewhere. Null otherwise.

risultati.description: Matching comuni, most similar name first, at most `limite`; empty when nothing resembles the text.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code, as a string with leading zeros kept: the `cod_istat` input of leggi_dati_comune.

provincia.description: Province (or metropolitan city) as recorded by ISTAT; null if not recorded.

regione.description: Region as recorded by ISTAT (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

title: Search Italian comuni by name
